question_feedback.explanation: Generative models learn data probability distributions to synthesize new data artifacts (text, image, code), while discriminative models calculate decision boundaries to classify or score existing inputs.
Grounding with Vertex AI Search retrieves relevant documents from enterprise datastores and provides them as contextual anchors to minimize hallucinations.
The self-attention mechanism within Transformer architectures computes attention weights between all token pairs simultaneously, overcoming sequential bottlenecking.
PEFT techniques like LoRA freeze base weights and update low-rank matrices, requiring orders of magnitude less memory and GPU compute.
Few-shot prompting conditions the model on a handful of exemplary demonstration pairs directly inside the context window before asking for the target output.
